items.title: Offline restart available

items.title: No mutation/provider controls
items.evidence: Owner directly confirmed no Edit, Save, Add, Delete, Publish, Sync, Provider, or Pin controls appear anywhere in the installed V2 web app; screenshots/library-reopen-readonly.png also labels the selection read-only with no mutation controls.

items.title: Three consecutive offline Home Screen cold launches
items.evidence: Owner reports three consecutive successful Home Screen cold launches in Airplane Mode with Wi-Fi/cellular off; each described as instant. Screenshot screenshots/offline-library-after-three-launches.png (SHA-256 b0a6006f1fef5ba4c5f4c4a15ace94bb2ab1e4630aef993c2ea651cd56282b8d) visibly shows Airplane Mode, Offline, and active verified IndexedDB snapshot.

items.title: Core library/status routes offline
items.evidence: Owner reports Library, Songs, Set Lists, and Status all open successfully offline; screenshot screenshots/offline-library-after-three-launches.png visibly shows offline Library and all four navigation tabs.

items.title: Song 1979 offline
items.evidence: Owner reports searching for and opening song 1979 succeeds while the installed web app remains in Airplane Mode.

items.title: 9Tease Stripped detail offline
items.evidence: Owner reports opening the 9Tease Stripped Set List succeeds while the installed web app remains in Airplane Mode.

items.title: Direct locked Live offline
items.evidence: Owner reports entering the direct locked Live view from 9Tease Stripped succeeds while the installed web app remains in Airplane Mode. Screenshot unavailable by design while disconnected; owner observation recorded.

items.title: Song search fields offline
items.evidence: Owner confirms all offline song-search field probes worked: cant stop found Can’t Stop; f sharp found All These Things That I’ve Done; lrclib and 108 found 3 AM. Some result sets were not unique; uniqueness is not required, and the expected reviewed item appeared.

items.title: Set List search fields offline
items.evidence: Owner confirms both offline Set List search probes worked: 2026-08-05 and Castello Golightly found 9Tease Stripped. Some result sets were not unique; uniqueness is not required, and the expected reviewed item appeared.

items.title: All 58 latest-set occurrences traverse offline
items.evidence: Owner reports traversing all 58 9Tease Stripped occurrences offline with no stale songs or skipped occurrences; screenshots/offline-live-occurrence-39-cant-stop.png (SHA-256 5086411b2f7e7558f78feed6a9bb258952c9952b02ffa7d90b843c8b351e49c7) visibly shows occurrence 39/58.

items.title: Bounded occurrence navigation
items.evidence: Owner confirms Previous/Next remain bounded and occurrence-based through the complete 58-item offline traversal, with no unpredictable navigation.

items.title: Bright and Stage Dark modes
items.evidence: Owner confirms Bright and Stage Dark themes both work offline; screenshots/offline-live-occurrence-39-cant-stop.png (SHA-256 5086411b2f7e7558f78feed6a9bb258952c9952b02ffa7d90b843c8b351e49c7) records the Bright-mode Live view and visible Stage Dark control.

items.title: Expected occurrence-39 warning
items.evidence: screenshots/offline-live-occurrence-39-cant-stop.png (SHA-256 5086411b2f7e7558f78feed6a9bb258952c9952b02ffa7d90b843c8b351e49c7) visibly records occurrence 39/58, Can’t Stop, with the expected frozen iPad-landscape warning and runtime fit warning.

items.title: Warning content remains scrollable/readable
items.evidence: Owner confirms occurrence-39 warning/song content remains readable by scrolling with no clipping; screenshots/offline-live-occurrence-39-cant-stop.png (SHA-256 5086411b2f7e7558f78feed6a9bb258952c9952b02ffa7d90b843c8b351e49c7) visibly shows the scroll-required warning and readable two-column content.

items.title: All five landscape-warning songs inspected
items.evidence: Owner confirms all five reviewed landscape-warning songs—Can’t Stop, Father of Mine, Love Shack, Paradise City, and Troublemaker—displayed their expected warnings and remained usable during the complete offline traversal.

items.title: Background/resume after 1 minute
items.evidence: Owner confirms backgrounding V2 for 1 minute and resuming offline preserved a safe, usable state.

items.title: Force-quit and offline reopen
items.evidence: Owner confirms force-quitting V2 and reopening from the Home Screen offline succeeded.

items.title: Reboot and offline reopen
items.evidence: DEFERRED with the extended Airplane-Mode lifecycle block on 2026-08-13. Status remains PENDING; this is not a failure.

items.title: Repeated orientation changes
items.evidence: Owner confirms repeated portrait/landscape rotations produced no stale or clipped Live content.

items.title: Orientation change on warning song
items.evidence: Owner confirms rotating while viewing Can’t Stop and its warning retained readable, usable content.

items.title: Storage diagnostics recorded without durability claim
items.evidence: screenshots/status-snapshot-storage-worker.png records persistence Granted (storage remains evictable), origin usage 7.18 MiB, quota 38.4 GiB, and headroom 38.4 GiB; no durability guarantee inferred.

items.title: No silently clipped false fit
items.evidence: Owner confirms the tested lifecycle/rotation views produced no silently clipped false fit; overflow remained warned/readable rather than hidden.
